articles.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6: FE Covenants — Enforcing covenants through cryptographically restricted signing keys
articles.snippet: FE covenants encode spending constraints into the signing key, so only transactions that satisfy a predefined condition can be signed.

articles.title: 'It Speaks in Tongues That Only 6.2 Astra Understands': Why Early Testers Hate OpenAI’s New Model
articles.snippet: OpenAI's flagship AI model is dazzling developers with 3D creations, but early testers say it stalls during long projects, gives baffling explanations, and hides failures.

articles.title: 'Doomed From the Start': President Trump's Meme Coin Hits New Lows After Midterms
articles.snippet: The TRUMP token has fallen almost 40% since election day, with analysts pointing to the Democrats’ subpoena plans, fading interest, and a heavy unlock schedule.

articles.title: OpenAI's GPT 6.2 Astra Challenges Anthropic on Price, But Not Every Benchmark
articles.snippet: OpenAI's latest models promise better professional work for less money, as the company battles Anthropic and Google for AI supremacy and faces tougher questions about increasingly capable systems and safety.

articles.title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says
articles.snippet: Luxor said hackers redirected hashrate from just over a dozen client accounts through its Commander tool, and its CEO blamed a “sophisticated AI-enabled vector.”
